body:
### Summary

We are using the official UV image in our multi-stage Docker build:

```dockerfile
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /usr/local/bin/
```

This was working fine for the last ~10 days without any changes on our side. It has now started failing during the Docker build.

### Error

```text
runc run failed: unable to start container process:
error during container init:
exec: "/bin/sh": stat /bin/sh: no such file or directory
```

The failure happens during container initialization, before `uv pip install` actually runs.

Could you please confirm whether `uv:latest` was recently updated and provide the previous UV version/digest so we can pin the previously working version?

### Environment

* Base image: `python:3.12-slim`
* UV image: `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest`
* Docker BuildKit
* Linux


### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-1051-azure x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

unknown - using ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest

### Python version

_No response_
title: ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest causing Docker build failure
